provenance.method: Dijkstra on selected OSM walking ways; nearest network nodes, not verified entrances. No live closures, node barriers, accessibility or turn restrictions. Endpoint gaps excluded from route distance.
provenance.buildingScope: Up to 900 simple building rings within 110m of sampled route vertices; complex relations and holes excluded. Heights without OSM height are estimates.
